Veterans Benefits: Washington has no state individual income tax. Qualifying veterans with disabilities and qualifying surviving spouses may receive income-based property-tax relief; VA disability compensation is excluded from the income calculation.

Description: Bellevue is a high-cost Eastside city in the Seattle metropolitan area, with Lake Washington access, a major technology employment base, nearby Cascade recreation, Overlake Medical Center, and nearby VA health care. It combines no state individual income tax and strong municipal LGBTQ policy with very expensive housing and a high combined sales-tax rate.
